profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. It reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker IBM with SEC CIK 0000051143.

The company's site focuses on IBM OpenPages, which it describes as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform for managing risk, compliance, and audit functions in a single integrated solution. OpenPages is available on any cloud or on-premises and offers a modular approach to governance, risk, and compliance. The site highlights embedded AI that automates classification and issue creation, an interactive workspace called the OpenPages GRC Canvas for modeling processes and controls with live data, and an OpenPages MCP Server that allows AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects. Integration with IBM's watsonx.ai or third-party AI models is supported through an API-based architecture. The site notes that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning, and that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment.

Beyond OpenPages, the held facts record two additional tracked products: IBM watsonx.governance, which covers AI lifecycle governance including model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation with EU AI Act accelerators and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026, and IBM watsonx, a broader enterprise AI platform described as model-agnostic and incorporating agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection capabilities.
